title: Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules with triple bonded Hidro
question:
Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules with triple bonded Hidrogen atoms.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+'), COUNT(molecule_id)) * 100.0 where element = 'h' AND bond_type = '#';

prediction.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.XCL_010) AS percentage FROM molecule AS "m" JOIN atom AS "a" ON "a".XCL_002 = "m".XCL_010 JOIN connected AS "c" ON "c".XCL_007 = "a".XCL_001 JOIN bond AS "b" ON "b".XCL_004 = "c".XCL_009 WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'h' AND b.XCL_006 = '#'

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
  COUNT(m.XCL_010) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
JOIN connected c ON c.XCL_007 = a.XCL_001
JOIN bond b ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'h'
  AND b.XCL_006 = '#';

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN m.XCL_010 END) * 100.0 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
JOIN connected c ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
JOIN atom a ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007
WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'h';
